messages:
alex: Standback — quick checkin. What I did: pushed gw-config PR to fix route priority (https://git.redwood/infra/pull/312). Blocker: staging e2e failing on JWT rotation TTL mismatch. Today: debug e2e, pair with @sam on the auth cron, and get a canary out if green.

maya: Saw the PR, left comments on the priority comparator. Suggest adding a unit test for tie-breaker and a short note in CHANGELOG.

sam: Re: JWT issue — I noticed the rotate job missed one run after the KMS key rollover. I restarted it: ```kubectl rollout restart cronjob/jwt-rotate -n infra-staging``` Watching logs now.

ops-bot: deploy triggered by alex — staging/gateway v1.12.3 — CI: 12/12 jobs passed — starting deploy to canary.

jules: Quick note on rate limits: canary pool still at 100r/s. I'm going to open an RFC to raise to 200r/s during peak and add a soft-failback at 250r/s. Keeping internal admin routes behind sticky routing.

alex: Good call. If e2e goes green I'll merge. @maya can you do a final skim on tests?

maya: Will do a quick pass. If tests are flaky we should add a short skip + ticket to stabilize. :thumbsup:

sam: Log snippet from the rotate job right after restart: ```time=\"2026-06-15T14:06:10Z\" level=info msg=\"rotate: started\" key=projects/redwood/kms-1```. No errors so far.

jules: FYI saw a tiny spike at 14:03 UTC — looks partner-side idle probe, not gateway bug. Added a sticky-route rule to protect /internal endpoints.

alex: OK, I'll re-run the staging e2e after a couple of successful rotate runs. If green, canary merge and I'll kick a rollout checklist.

maya: small ops request — can we add a short note in the console about the new tie-breaker behavior? Saves UX confusion.

sam: I'll add it to the infra docs page under \"routing behavior\".

jules: I'll track the OKR card for gateway SLOs and put a tracking ticket for the rate change. Link: https://boards.redwood/okr/1723

alex: Thanks team — blocking items: e2e + one more rotate run. Will update thread in 10–15. :coffee:
